title: RTP: Use the extended sequence number to count cycles
description:
The extended sequence number in the RTP dissector is better
than what the tap is currently doing. For example, the tap
right now counts extra cycles if out of order packets occur
causing extra crossings of 0.

It's still not quite the algorithm in RFC 3350 A.1, but this
works for more cases than before.

Add some documentation to the analysis struct.

Fix #19895
